rules.title: Circular Dependency
rules.description: Cycle in Hard Dependency / Inheritance graph.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if hard/inheritance subgraph is not a DAG.

rules.title: Missing Parent Dependency
rules.description: Required parent target missing for hard/inheritance dependency.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if target_id unresolved for level_id=hard_dependency|inheritance.
rules.recommended_resolution: Author parent record or downgrade level with override policy.

rules.title: Missing Child Dependency Declaration
rules.description: Parent inventory lists child hard-deps but child does not declare DEPENDS_ON/FOUNDATIONAL link.
rules.detection_rule: WARN on asymmetric pack inventory vs child declarations.

rules.title: Orphan Node
rules.description: Record has neither inbound nor outbound dependencies and is not a designated root.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if degree==0 outside approved roots (e.g. KR-000001).
rules.recommended_resolution: Attach dependencies or document root status.

rules.title: Reference Used As Hard Gate
rules.description: Reference-level link counted as satisfying Hard Dependency.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if release gate accepts reference as hard.

rules.title: Dependency Graph Incomplete
rules.description: dependency_manifest missing edges required by pack design.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if pack design foundations absent from manifest.

rules.title: Hard Override Attempt
rules.description: Attempt to waive Hard Dependency without allowed policy.
rules.recommended_resolution: Do not waive Hard Dependency for official release.

rules.title: Extension Missing Base Record
rules.description: Extension level without named base target.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if level_id=extension and base target blank.

rules.title: Pack Level Dependency Cycle
rules.description: Packs hard-depend on each other cyclically.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if pack depends_on_packs graph cyclic.
rules.recommended_resolution: Reorder pack dependencies; Pack 01 must not depend downstream.

rules.title: Semantic Dependency Undocumented
rules.description: Definition presupposes another concept without semantic/hard declaration.
rules.detection_rule: WARN if prose presupposition without DEP level.
rules.recommended_resolution: Declare semantic_dependency or upgrade to hard.

rules.title: Soft Dependency Elevated Silently
rules.description: Soft dependency treated as hard without review.
rules.detection_rule: WARN on silent elevation in gates.

rules.title: Dependency Target Immutable ID Violation
rules.description: Dependency retargeted by remapping KR-* identity.
rules.detection_rule: FAIL if fixing deps by changing record_id.
